la_maison_i_decrit_votre_maniere_spontan: House I describes your spontaneous way of entering life, your presence, your appearance, and how you assert your individuality.
la_maison_ii_concerne_vos_ressources_vot: House II concerns your resources, your relationship with money, your sense of security, and the values on which you build your stability.
la_maison_iii_decrit_votre_maniere_d_app: House III describes your way of learning, communicating, conveying your ideas, and interacting with your immediate environment.
la_maison_iv_represente_vos_racines_votr: House IV represents your roots, your family, your home, your emotional memory, and the most private foundations of your personality.
la_maison_v_concerne_votre_creativite_vo: House V concerns your creativity, your ability to shine, your pleasures, your romantic impulses, and how you express your uniqueness.
la_maison_vi_decrit_votre_organisation_q: House VI describes your daily organization, your concrete work, your habits, your sense of service, and your relationship to well-being.
la_maison_vii_represente_les_relations_e: House VII represents committed relationships, the couple, associations, and the qualities you seek or discover through others.
la_maison_viii_concerne_l_intimite_les_r: House VIII concerns intimacy, shared resources, crises, deep attachments, and your capacity for inner transformation.
la_maison_ix_represente_votre_vision_du_: House IX represents your worldview, your beliefs, higher education, travel, and your need to expand your understanding of life.
la_maison_x_decrit_votre_vocation_votre_: House X describes your vocation, your ambition, your public image, your relationship to success, and the contribution you wish to leave.
la_maison_xi_concerne_les_amities_les_gr: House XI concerns friendships, groups, networks, collective projects, and the aspirations you build for the future.
la_maison_xii_represente_votre_vie_inter: House XII represents your deep inner life, the unconscious, periods of withdrawal, compassion, and the more subtle dimensions of your existence.
une_maison_i_occupee_accentue_le_besoin_: An occupied House I emphasizes the need to act according to your own impulse and to develop a clearly defined identity.
une_maison_ii_occupee_met_l_accent_sur_l: An occupied House II highlights the construction of security, material autonomy, and the recognition of your own value.
une_maison_iii_occupee_renforce_le_besoi: An occupied House III reinforces the need to understand, exchange, learn, and create connections through ideas and speech.
une_maison_iv_occupee_intensifie_l_impor: An occupied House IV intensifies the importance of home, roots, family, and the feeling of emotional security.
une_maison_v_occupee_souligne_la_creativ: An occupied House V underscores creativity, personal expression, pleasure, romance, and the need to leave a unique mark.
une_maison_vi_occupee_met_l_accent_sur_l: An occupied House VI emphasizes organization, usefulness, daily responsibilities, and the gradual improvement of your life.
une_maison_vii_occupee_rend_les_relation: An occupied House VII makes relationships essential to your evolution. Others become important mirrors of your personality.
une_maison_viii_occupee_indique_une_gran: An occupied House VIII indicates great emotional depth and experiences capable of permanently transforming your way of living.
une_maison_ix_occupee_renforce_le_besoin: An occupied house IX enhances the need to seek meaning, broaden your horizons, and develop a personal vision of the world.
une_maison_x_occupee_souligne_l_importan: An occupied house X emphasizes the importance of vocation, recognition, responsibilities, and building a lasting legacy.
une_maison_xi_occupee_favorise_les_proje: An occupied house XI promotes future projects, networks, collective causes, and relationships based on a shared vision.
une_maison_xii_occupee_accentue_la_sensi: An occupied house XII accentuates sensitivity, intuition, inner life, and the need to understand unconscious mechanisms.
les_maisons_indiquent_dans_quels_domaine: The houses indicate in which areas of your existence the planetary energies express themselves most directly. An occupied house often becomes an important place of experience, learning, and evolution.
une_maison_vide_ne_signifie_pas_qu_un_do: An empty house does not mean that an area of life is absent or unimportant. It simply indicates that none of the ten main planets were placed there at the time of your birth.
